proposed_capability: Add project-scoped Cursor pre-effect gates that refuse risky host shell commands, arbitrary file deletes, protected saves and peripheral changes without changing desktop services or user settings.
player_save_control_impact: No OS, peripherals, preferences, EA saves, user files, or local hook installations are mutated by this repository change. Rules gate future project-scoped agent operations on supported Cursor versions.
expected_outcome: Fail-closed Cursor project hook refuses unsafe shell execution, protected file deletion/write and direct risky tool calls; permits narrow read-only diagnostics and isolated offline tests.
negative_tests: Refuse service/driver/device/registry/screenshot preference mutation and shell indirection
Refuse save deletion and paths outside repository for tool writes
Refuse attempts to disable guard files
Refuse unknown commands, malformed inputs, symlinks or ambiguous scope; allow well-known read-only diagnostics
rollback_path: Remove the feature branch or revert the isolated hook/contract/tests; leave original PR160 and Windows host unchanged.
unresolved_unknowns: Cursor project hook load and enforcement on operator host must be verified locally.
Non-Cursor tools, direct computer-use interaction and out-of-repo agents are not automatically controlled by project hooks.
